name: trishul
description: TRISHUL - AI-assisted women and teen safety ecosystem (Kolkata and Howrah)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix client && npm test --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
